summary: Full-stack testing of Khaitan EduOps site. 9/9 backend pytest tests pass (health, root, contact CRUD + validation, demo CRUD + validation). All frontend flows verified via Playwright: hero kinetic headline, desktop sidebar + smooth-scroll manifesto nav to 5 sections, all 7 pillar cards, pillar detail page (KOSMOS ERP), unknown slug redirect to /, About page headline, Contact page with both forms, contact + demo submit -> success toast + cleared, contact empty-email validation toast, footer 'Book a demo' -> /contact, and mobile drawer opens on 390px viewport. No functional issues found.

issues: Non-blocking warnings: 'useScroll target ref not yet hydrated' (in Hero or child using useScroll before hydration) and 'container has a non-static position'. Consider making the scroll target container `relative` or invoking useScroll in the same component as the ref.

action_items: Optional: silence framer-motion useScroll hydration warnings by ensuring the scroll target has non-static position and useScroll is called after ref is attached.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: `logger` is initialized after the route handlers reference it. It still works because the name resolves at call time, but it is fragile — move logger init above route definitions.
server.py: contact and demo endpoints have identical shape — consider a shared submission helper to DRY the insert + logging.
server.py: uses deprecated @app.on_event('shutdown'); prefer FastAPI lifespan context manager.
Frontend Hero.jsx / useScroll produces hydration warnings; not blocking but should be cleaned up.
seed_data_creation: TEST_-prefixed contact and demo submissions inserted in `contact_submissions` and `demo_submissions` collections during API + Playwright tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py at /app/backend/tests covers all API contracts. Frontend uses window.__lenis smooth scroll; wait ~1.5-2s between smooth-scroll actions. Hero anim staggers ~1.6s. Sonner toasts appear bottom-right — assert on body text since they render in a portal.
